summary: Recent discussions focus on extending Parquet’s logical type support, refining versioning strategy, and expanding encoding options. A proposal adds MIN_LENGTH and MAX_LENGTH metadata to enable a fixed‑length VECTOR(N) type. Another thread outlines a two‑tier format change model—add‑everywhere and compatibility level—to accelerate feature rollout while preserving reader correctness, and contributors are encouraged to add new encodings such as pcode, FSST, and PFOR.

highlights.text: Adding MIN_LENGTH and MAX_LENGTH metadata for VECTOR(N) logical type
